hero.description: Track what you watch, rate what you love, and always know what's next — across movies, TV series, and anime.

features.title: Built for the way you actually watch.
features.description: No spreadsheets, no half-finished notes, no “what was that show called?” Your entire watch life, finally in one place.
features.libraryBody: Movies, series, and anime live side by side — not scattered across three different apps.
features.statusBody: Move a title from planned to watching to finished with a single click.
features.searchBody: Search a full catalog and add any title to your stash without leaving the page.
features.ratingBody: Score every finished title and leave a note, so future-you knows exactly why it mattered.
features.ratingNote: “That final shot lived in my head for days.”
features.progressBody: Track seasons and episodes as you go, then pick up right where you stopped.

how.title: From “what should I watch?” to watching it.
how.description: Three steps. About a minute. Then a lifetime of better movie nights.
how.oneBody: Sign up free with email, Google, or GitHub. Your stash is ready in seconds.
how.twoBody: Search movies, series, and anime. Add them with a status and you're set.
how.threeBody: Track your progress, rate what you finish, and leave notes for the next rewatch.

faq.title: Good questions.
faq.description: The short version of everything you might be wondering.
faq.freeA: Yes. WatchStash is free to use, with no credit card and no trial timer. Create an account and start stashing.
faq.trackA: Movies, TV series, and anime. Give each title a status, rating, personal note, and — for series and anime — season and episode progress.
faq.syncQ: Will my stash stay in sync?
faq.syncA: Yes. Your stash is tied to your account, so your library is there when you sign in again on another browser.
faq.phoneQ: Does WatchStash work on my phone?
faq.phoneA: WatchStash is desktop-first for now. A dedicated mobile experience is on the way — the site is best enjoyed on a laptop or desktop browser today.
faq.dataQ: Where does the catalog come from?
faq.dataA: Title data and artwork come from TMDB. Your ratings, notes, and progress are yours.

cta.title: Your watchlist has been waiting.
cta.description: Make room for the stories you keep meaning to get to. Your next favorite is one stash away.
cta.note: Free forever · No credit card · Ready in under a minute

footer.tagline: A calmer home for everything you watch.
footer.closer: Made for people who watch too much. No such thing.
